evals.name: auth-regression
evals.prompt: can you review the pending change in review.patch before i merge it? don't change anything
evals.expected_output: Reports one important finding at src/gateway.py lines 25-30: the cache lookup now runs before the authorization check and the cache key no longer includes the actor, so any caller, including anonymous ones, receives another user's cached private profile. Does not report the quote normalization, which matches the project rule. Leaves the tree unchanged.

assertions.text: A finding is reported at src/gateway.py lines 25-30
The quote change at src/gateway.py line 23 is not reported
The authorization finding names a concrete trigger: a different or anonymous caller requesting a profile that another request already cached
The supplied review fixture is unchanged

evals.name: ssrf-host-vs-path
evals.prompt: Security review please: review.patch adds two outbound HTTP helpers to our chat backend. Is it safe to ship?
evals.expected_output: Reports server-side request forgery in fetch_preview (src/previews.py lines 8-12): a logged-in user controls the full URL, so the server can be made to request internal services or the metadata endpoint. Does not report fetch_status, where the user controls only an escaped path segment on a fixed internal host.

assertions.text: A finding is reported at src/previews.py lines 8-12
No finding is reported at src/previews.py lines 15-19
The supplied review fixture is unchanged

evals.name: sound-change
evals.prompt: review.patch adds a discount option to invoice_total. quick review before merge?
evals.expected_output: Reports no findings and states clearly that the change has no issues. The change is correct: the discount must be an integer from 0 to 100, it is applied once to the subtotal with half-up rounding to cents, and the default keeps the old behavior. Missing tests for the discount and the 'security reviewed' comment are not findings.

assertions.text: The response reports no findings at a file:line location
The response gives an explicit verdict that no issues were found, rather than ending without a conclusion
The supplied review fixture is unchanged

evals.name: pre-existing-bug
evals.prompt: Please review the change in review.patch for the audit-log pagination.
evals.expected_output: Reports page_slice (src/paging.py lines 9-12) as an important finding: pages are zero-based, so page 0 computes start = -size and returns an empty or wrong slice. Lists page_count (line 6) as pre-existing, because its floor division drops a partial last page but the diff does not change it.

assertions.text: A finding is reported at src/paging.py lines 9-12
src/paging.py line 4-6 is listed as pre-existing and not as a finding
The supplied review fixture is unchanged
